newsitem.title: GUATEMALA: Guatemala October CPI slows to 0.38 percent.
newsitem.headline: Guatemala October CPI slows to 0.38 percent.

text.p: Guatemalan consumer prices rose 0.38 percent in October, compared to a rise of 1.40 percent in the same month last year, the National Statistic Institute said on Friday.
September inflation this year was 0.34 percent.
Accumulated inflation was 8.67 percent at the end of October, compared with 6.68 percent a year ago, the institute said.
Year-over-year inflation was 10.64 percent on October 31, down from 11.77 percent as of September 30. Year-over-year inflation at the end of October 1995 was 8.69 percent.
